title: Software Factories

venue.name: Zelifcam
venue.address: 10200 San Pedro Ave, San Antonio, TX, 78216

description: Writing code got fast. Reviewing code is still catching up. But the harder problem is already here: knowing what to build in the first place. A software factory codifies how you work so you can spend less time on the mechanics of shipping and more time on the work that actually matters, like system design, verification, and making sure you're building the right thing. This talk covers where the bottleneck has been, where it's going, and how a software factory might be a useful tool in your back pocket for shipping the right thing at work or on personal projects.

title: Byte Night

venue.name: Zelifcam
venue.address: 10200 San Pedro Ave, San Antonio, TX, 78216

description:
Byte Night is a laid-back gathering for programmers, tech folks, indie hackers, and curious minds in San Antonio who just want to hang out, talk shop, share ideas, and code together.

No pressure, no pitches — just good conversations about programming, business, tech trends, side projects, and whatever else comes up. Bring your laptop if you want to hack on something, or just come for the company and the chatter.

Whether you're building the next big thing, tinkering with personal projects, or just looking to meet other people who *get* it, you’re welcome here.

✨ **What to expect:**

* Chill vibes and great conversations
* People working on cool stuff (or nothing at all)
* Tech talk, idea-sharing, and occasional brainstorming
* Everyone from seasoned devs to beginners welcome
* Probably tacos or coffee involved (this is San Antonio, after all)

**Come hang out. Let’s talk code, life, and everything in between.**
**We have a donation area for the San Antonio Food Bank! Don't forget to bring non-perishable items to help out.**

title: Build Your Own AI Agent with Hermes

venue.name: Zelifcam
venue.address: 10200 San Pedro Ave, San Antonio, TX, 78216

description:
AI agents aren't science fiction; they're running businesses right now. Hermes isn't a chatbot. It's an agent with file system access, terminal control, persistent memory, scheduled automation, and the ability to connect to Discord, Telegram, and your email. Brandon Howard will walk through how he uses Hermes day to day, what broke, what he fixed, and how to set it up from scratch. This is not a polished demo. It's an honest look at what happens when AI actually does the work. What we'll cover:

* Real use cases — not theory, not hype
* What breaks and how to make it stick
* SOUL.md, skills, cron jobs, and memory (Mnemosyne)
* Platform connections: Discord, Telegram, email

Please feel free to follow along. Computer troubleshooting will not be part of this event. This is a demonstration. Full notes will be provided at the end of the event.

title: ATC After Dark - SPACEBALLS

venue.name: Zelifcam
venue.address: 10200 San Pedro Ave, San Antonio, TX, 78216

description:
**May the Schwartz be with you.**
ATC is clearing the parking lot for an outdoor screening of the greatest Star Wars parody ever committed to film: Spaceballs.

Mel Brooks doing double duty, a ship the size of a small country, Dark Helmet and his comically oversized headgear, and jokes that break the fourth wall so hard they escape the theater. It's ludicrous speed from start to finish. Come watch it on a big screen under the stars with your fellow San Antonio devs and sci-fi enthusiasts.

## The Vibe

1. Outdoor screening in the ATC lot, lights, big screen, summer night
2. Bring a camp chair or a blanket. Bring a +1.
3. Popcorn machine on site. Drinks provided.

## What to Bring

1. A folding chair or blanket (we’ve got limited seating, so BYO is the move)
2. A light layer; September nights in SA can still surprise you
3. Bug spray if you’re the mosquito-magnet type

## Good To Know

1. Rated PG. Family/+1 friendly, but use your judgment for the little ones.
2. Starts 8:00 PM; film rolls at dusk (8:20 PM) once it’s dark enough to see the screen.
3. Weather call: if the forecast turns on us, we’ll move indoors; watch the Meetup + Discord for updates.

*This is what a tech community looks like when it logs off for a night. Pull up a chair.*
*Alamo Tech Collective*
RSVP so we know how much popcorn to make. 🍿
